authority.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1

sections.20.4.98: Inline TABLECONTENT cell-content-geometry ends with BL 'Unknown flags'.
sections.20.4.103: Standalone TABLEGEOMETRY rows contain content geometry whose final group-95 field is BD 'Unknown (0)'.

finding: These entries describe separate storage contexts. The standalone TABLEGEOMETRY BD statement does not contradict the inline TABLECONTENT BL statement.

currentImplementationCheck.standaloneParser: DRW_TableGeometry::parseDwg reads the final field using readBitDoubleWithinBody and retains m_dwgUnknownValue.
currentImplementationCheck.generatedControl: libdxfrw_tablegeometry_dwg_bd_tail constructs a nonzero BD field and checks exact value retention plus following cell-handle alignment.
currentImplementationCheck.result: Focused generated test passes; this is parser/codec consistency only.

remainingEvidence: No traceable physical producer source with a nonzero standalone TABLEGEOMETRY BD value has been found in the current corpus.
Native TABLE cache interpretation/rendering, non-null cell target graph closure, and broad producer qualification remain open.
decision: Keep the current parser and null-reference DXF output profile. This receipt corrects the cross-context description only; it does not satisfy the independent source-span gate and does not authorize a DWG writer or support-claim promotion.
supersedes: The wording in p6-tablegeometry-group95-profile-census-2026-11-02.json that treats the two ODA sections as one contradictory shared field; its census and generated-control observations remain historical evidence.
